7.1.9.14 SetLogChannelThreshold
[SWS_Dlt_00723] ⌈If the Dlt command Dlt_SetLogChannelThreshold is re-
quested, the DltLogChannelThreshold of the addressed LogChannel shall be set
to the value received by the parameter newThreshold
⌋
[SWS_Dlt_00724] ⌈If the Dlt command Dlt_SetLogChannelThreshold is re-
quested and the logChannelName and/or the newThreshold is unknown, the Dlt
command shall return DLT_E_ERROR.⌋
caption: 7.1.9.14 SetLogChannelThreshold
